fr.elements: Main Residence; Detached Structure; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Drive; Walkway; Open Green Space; Patio Area; Landscaped Area; Solar Panel System; Equipment Storage Area
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Multiple Structures; Limited Rear Access; Detached Structure Complexity
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions of approach.
• Mark the detached structure with a visible unit identifier so responders can distinguish it from the main residence during an incident.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between buildings without obstruction.
• Post the solar panel system location and shutoff point in a visible location near the main electrical panel or primary entry point for responding crews.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles so emergency apparatus can reach the rear of the property.
• Mark any rear access point with a reflective indicator so responders can locate it quickly from the access drive.
• Keep the rear gate or access point unlocked, or install a Knox-type lock, so responders can reach the rear of the property without delay.
• Keep the equipment storage area clear of the access drive so vehicles and personnel can pass without obstruction.
• Trim any landscaping along the access drive that narrows the travel width or reduces overhead clearance for emergency vehicles.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Scattered Trees; Open Terrain; Multiple Access Routes; Irrigated Landscape; None Visible
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing directly next to the house or any outbuildings.
• Separate shrub clusters from each other to reduce connected plant material around structures.
• Remove any dead branches or dried material from shrubs near the house.
• Thin trees where their canopies touch or overlap close to the structure.
• Keep low branches on trees near the house trimmed up from the ground.
• Maintain open ground between individual trees and nearby shrubs.
• Keep irrigated lawn and planting areas watered and actively maintained through dry periods.
• Clear any dead or dry plant material that accumulates along the edges of irrigated areas where they meet open terrain.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching shrubs.
• Maintain enough width on all driveways and entry routes for a vehicle to pass through without obstruction.
